Fresh Mark’s meat manufacturing process and testing procedures operate 24 hours a day, six to seven days a week. Any disruption can potentially jeopardize an entire batch of products. By 2021, as the company’s four Ohio locations continued to add capacity and products, keeping round-the-clock production humming began to tax the aging technology ecosystem. Computer issues occasionally slowed operations, requiring immediate IT attention to resolve the problem. Given the pace of operations and the company’s high standards, such issues were unacceptable. Leadership soon prioritized research into new technology solutions that would ensure high performance, improve efficiency, and facilitate future scaling.
